reports.title: Report on review of interim condensed

desk.headline: Revenue up 11% to R$5.16bn, just above estimate; EPS R$2.69 below estimate; new R$1.5bn buyback and R$1.3bn dividend; no guidance
results: Total revenue and income rose 11% to R$5.16bn, slightly ahead of the analysts' R$5.12bn; on the company's own net revenue measure growth was 9%.
Pre-tax profit rose 18%, but a much higher tax charge (R$190m vs almost nil a year ago) held net profit growth to 5%, at R$1.38bn.
Diluted EPS of R$2.69 was up 9% thanks to fewer shares, but below the R$2.78 estimate.
Retail revenue grew 11% to R$4.1bn and the wholesale bank 13% to R$1.2bn; client assets reached R$1.57tn, though net inflows fell 26% to R$22bn.
XP announced a new R$1.5bn buyback, R$1.3bn of dividends and the cancellation of about 11.7m treasury shares; its BIS capital ratio was 20.3%.

guidance.summary: XP gave no financial guidance or targets with these results.

watch: Whether net inflows recover after the 26% drop.
The tax rate, which rose sharply and cut into profit growth.
Credit quality as the loan book grows quickly (up 28% in a year).
